evidence.observation: Pressure held at about 2.91–2.96 Torr throughout the ramp at 100 sccm Ar.
Pressure climbed steadily during growth: 2.979, 3.038, 3.097, 3.177, 3.249 Torr, while Ar flow stayed constant.
Ar flow reads 99.6–100.7 sccm, on setpoint, so the rise is not caused by extra flow.
Temperature settled at 749.8 °C after a small overshoot to 760 °C, and heater power looks normal, so the thermal side is behaving.
No O2 sensor is installed, so I can't check whether air is getting in.

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust O2 or another leak check, such as a rate-of-rise test with the valve closed or checking the exhaust line/pump, would tell a seal leak apart from an exhaust blockage. No growth-stage reference statistics are available either.
